jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Bis zu 40 % Homeoffice möglich | Referenz 8324

Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team und agilen Umfeld

und Testautomatisierung ist deine Stärke? Dann werde Senior Test Engineer bei Terravis und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir intelligente, skalierbare Lösungen entwickeln.

Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse und Grundstücktranskationen. Als Teil unseres Teams Business Engineering & Testing arbeitest du eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um das Angebot rund um Terravis weiterzuentwickeln und zu optimieren. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und DevOps zusammen und gibst dein Testing-Know-how im Team weiter.

• Durchführung von manuellen Tests auf Basis der Internen-Anforderungen / Kundenanforderungen, Dokumentation und Analyse der Testergebnisse.

• Erstellung von aussagekräftigen Jira-Tickets als Grundlage für das Bugfixing bei der Entwicklung und gleichzeitig als Entscheidungshilfe für das Releasemanagement.

• Ausführung und Dokumentation automatisierter Tests.

• Unterstützung beim Refactoring der bestehenden Testautomaten und der Entwicklung einer skalierbaren Testautomatisierungslösung.

Das bringst du mit

• Testarchitektur – Du kennst den Aufbau wartbarer und konfigurierbaren Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks aus der Praxis. Testdaten beschaffst und pflegst du eigenständig über Schnittstellen wie SQL-Server oder Excel und schaffst damit die Grundlage für reproduzierbares manuelles wie automatisiertes Testen.

• Fehleranalyse und Reporting – Fähigkeit, Fehlerursachen im Testlauf (inkl. Logs, Screenshots, Reports) zu identifizieren und zu beheben. Erstellen von aussagekräftigen Tickets für Bugs, welche mit den funktionalen Tests im Testsubjekt gefunden werden.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Testautomationen – Sicherer Umgang mit Selenium-Webdriver und Cucumber. Du schreibst wartbare Test-Szenarien und implementierst die dazugehörigen Step-Definitionen browserübergreifend (Chrome, Edge) gegen unsere Webapplikation. Fundierte Erfahrung in Java und Maven setzen wir voraus. JavaScript-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Frameworks und Tools – Erfahrung mit Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab und JIRA.

• Sprachen - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

SIX promuove la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una combinazione unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondamenta e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare con noi il futuro dei mercati finanziari.

Ingegnere di Test Senior (80-100%)

Zurigo | Possibilità di lavorare da casa fino al 40 % | Riferimento 8324

Ti piace lavorare in un team dinamico e in un ambiente agile

e l'automazione dei test è il tuo punto di forza? Allora diventa Senior Test Engineer presso Terravis e contribuisci attivamente a definire come sviluppiamo soluzioni intelligenti e scalabili.

In qualità di piattaforma digitale leader, Terravis stabilisce nuovi standard nella gestione digitale intersettoriale delle transazioni immobiliari e collega il settore finanziario, il notariato e i registri fondiari per processi immobiliari e transazioni fondiarie sicuri, efficienti e conformi alla legge. Come parte del nostro team Business Engineering & Testing, collabori a stretto contatto con stakeholder interni ed esterni per sviluppare e ottimizzare ulteriormente l'offerta di Terravis. Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura.

Queste sono le tue mansioni

- Collabori a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo e DevOps e condividi con il team il tuo know-how in materia di testing.
- Esecuzione di test manuali sulla base dei requisiti interni / dei requisiti dei clienti, documentazione e analisi dei risultati dei test.
- Creazione di ticket Jira significativi come base per la correzione dei bug da parte dello sviluppo e, al contempo, come ausilio decisionale per la gestione delle release.
- Esecuzione e documentazione di test automatizzati.
- Supporto al refactoring degli strumenti di test esistenti e allo sviluppo di una soluzione scalabile per l'automazione dei test.

Il tuo profilo

- Architettura dei test – Conosci per esperienza pratica la struttura di framework di automazione dei test manutenibili e configurabili. Reperisci e mantieni autonomamente i dati di test tramite interfacce come SQL-Server o Excel, creando così le basi per test manuali e automatizzati riproducibili.
- Analisi degli errori e reporting – Capacità di identificare e risolvere le cause degli errori durante l'esecuzione dei test (inclusi log, screenshot, report). Creazione di ticket significativi per i bug rilevati con i test funzionali sul sistema sottoposto a test.
- Padronanza dell'automazione dei test – Padronanza di Selenium-Webdriver e Cucumber. Scrivi scenari di test manutenibili e implementi le relative definizioni degli step su più browser (Chrome, Edge) per la nostra applicazione web. Diamo per scontata una solida esperienza in Java e Maven. La conoscenza di JavaScript costituisce un vantaggio.
- Framework e strumenti – Esperienza con Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab e JIRA.
- Lingue - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia nella forma scritta sia in quella parlata.

Contatti

Per qualsiasi domanda, visita la nostra pagina delle FAQ oppure contatta Beata Czyzewska ai numeri +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa posizione prendiamo in considerazione esclusivamente candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, pertanto saremo lieti di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What distinguishes us is driving us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mix of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich, Up to 40% HomeOffice possible, Reference 8324

You like working in a dynamic team and a agile environment

and test automation is your strength? Then become Senior Test Engineer at Terravis and actively shape how we develop smart, scalable solutions.

As a leading digital platform, Terravis sets standards in the domain-wide digital processing of property business and connects the financial industry, notarial and land accounting for secure, efficient and legally compliant property processes and property transactions. As part of our Business Engineering & Testing team, you work closely with internal and external stakeholders to further develop and optimize the range of services around Terravis. We look forward to receiving your application documents.

These are your tasks

- You work closely with development and DevOps and pass on your expertise in the team in the field of development.
- Conduct manual tests based on internal requirements / customer requirements, documentation and analysis of test results.
- Creation of meaningful Jira tickets as the basis for bugfixing during development and at the same time as a decision-making aid for release management.
- Execution and documentation of automated tests.
- Support for re-factoring of existing test machines and the development of a scalable test automation solution.

You bring this with you

- Test architecture – You know how to build up repairable and configurable test automation frameworks from practice. You can process and process test data independently via interfaces such as SQL servers or Excel and thus create the basis for reproducible manual and automated testing.
- Error Analysis and Reporting – Ability to identify and fix bugs in the test run (including logs, screenshots, and reports). Create meaningful tickets for bugs that are found with the functional tests in the test subject.
- Safe handling of test automations – Safe handling of selenium webdriver and cucumber. You write time-proven test scenarios and implement the corresponding step definitions across browsers (Chrome, Edge) against our web application. We require a well-founded experience in Java and Maven. JavaScript knowledge is an advantage.
- Frameworks and Tools – Experience with Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucbridge, JDBC, jabsimport, smart bear SOAP-UI, GitLab and JIRA.
- Languages - Very good German and English language skills.

Contact

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

For this vacancy we take into account only direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we are happy about applications regardless of the personal background.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

SIX est à l'origine de la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous conduit à l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits intelligents et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Ingénieur de tests senior (80-100%)

Zurich, Jusqu'à 40% HomeOffice possible, Référence 8324

Vous aimez travailler dans une équipe dynamique et un environnement d'image

Et l'automatisation des tests est votre force? Puis devenir Ingénieur Principal de Test chez Terravis et façonner activement la façon dont nous développons des solutions intelligentes et évolutives.

Terravis, plateforme numérique de pointe, établit des normes dans le domaine du traitement numérique des affaires immobilières et relie l'industrie financière, le notariat et la comptabilité foncière pour des processus immobiliers et des transactions immobilières sûrs, efficaces et conformes à la loi. Dans le cadre de notre équipe d'ingénierie et de test d'affaires, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes pour développer et optimiser la gamme de services autour de Terravis.

Ce sont vos tâches

- Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le développement et DevOps et vos commentaires sur votre expertise dans l'équipe dans le domaine du développement.
- Effectuer des essais manuels en fonction des exigences internes et des exigences des clients, de la documentation et de l'analyse des résultats des essais.
- Création de billets Jira significatifs comme base pour la fixation de bugs pendant le développement et en même temps comme une aide à la prise de décision pour la gestion des libérations.
- Exécution et documentation des tests automatisés.
- Soutien à la refacturation des machines d'essai existantes et au développement d'une solution d'automatisation d'essai évolutive.

Apporte ça avec toi.

- Architecture de test – Vous savez comment construire des cadres d'automatisation de test réparables et configurables à partir de la pratique. Vous pouvez traiter et traiter les données de test indépendamment via des interfaces telles que des serveurs SQL ou Excel et ainsi créer la base pour des tests manuels et automatisés reproductibles.
- Analyse des erreurs et rapports – Possibilité d'identifier et de corriger les bogues dans l'exécution du test (y compris les journaux, les captures d'écran et les rapports).
- Manipulation sécuritaire des automatismes de test – Manipulation sécuritaire du webdriver et du concombre du sélénium. Vous écrivez des scénarios de test éprouvés dans le temps et implémentez les définitions d'étapes correspondantes dans les navigateurs (Chrome, Edge) contre notre application web.
- Cadres et outils – Expérience avec Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucbridge, JDBC, jabsimport, smart bear SOAP-UI, GitLab et JIRA.
- Langues - Très bonnes compétences en allemand et anglais.

Personne à contacter

Si vous avez des questions, veuillez consulter notre page FAQ ou contacter Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

Pour cette vacance, nous ne prenons en compte que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, donc nous sommes heureux des applications indépendamment de l'expérience personnelle.

jobs.title: Specialist Settlement (80%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten, Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 7912

Hast du Freude daran, komplexe Finanzprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und sicherzustellen, dass auch Ausnahme-Situationen effizient gelöst werden? Das Team Settlement Special Services gewährleistet zentrale Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertschriftenabwicklung bei SIX SIS. Im Bereich Exception Handling übernehmen wir die Überwachung und Verarbeitung aller non-STP-Swift-Meldungen sowie verschiedener Kontrollreports. Mit einer proaktiven Steuerung unserer Prozesse und Risiken stellen wir einen zuverlässigen Betrieb und einen hohen Servicelevel sicher.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine(n) SpezialistIn Settlement, die/der Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Verantwortung und ein dynamisches Umfeld mitbringt. Wir bieten dir eine spannende, vielseitige Position mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice. Mindestens drei Arbeitstage pro Woche verbringst du im Büro – wahlweise in Zürich oder Olten. Ein gemeinsamer Teamtag pro Woche findet fix in Olten statt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Koordination und Kommunikation mit internen und externen Schnittstellen, darunter Network Management, Depotstellen in verschiedenen Ländern, ICSDs, CSDs, Client Relationship Manager, Corporate Actions, Valorenstammdaten und Reconciliation

• Zeitgerechte Verarbeitung von non-STP Swift-Nachrichten (MT54x) von über 50 Ländern

• Investigation und Korrekturverbuchung von Reconciliationbreaks

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Abwicklungsabläufe sowie Pflege und Weiterentwicklung

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung; idealerweise mit Banklehre oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation

• Fundiertes Fachwissen im Wertschriftenbereich, sowie praktische Erfahrung im Tagesgeschäft; mehrjährige Erfahrung im Settlement ist wünschenswert

• Teamorientierte, engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Eigeninitiative und klarer, adressatengerechter Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie hohe Zuverlässigkeit und ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Regolazione specialistica (80%)

Olten, Zurich | Fino al 40% di sede possibile | Riferimento 7912

Ti piace modellare attivamente processi finanziari complessi e garantire che situazioni eccezionali siano risolte in modo efficiente? Il team Settlement Special Services garantisce servizi centralizzati di elaborazione titoli presso SIX SIS. Nell'ambito della gestione delle eccezioni, siamo responsabili del monitoraggio e dell'elaborazione di tutti i messaggi non-STP-Swift e di vari rapporti di controllo. Controllando proattivamente i nostri processi e rischi, garantiamo un funzionamento affidabile e un alto livello di servizio.

Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando uno specialista in Settlement che ha il desiderio di diversi compiti, responsabilità e un ambiente dinamico. Vi offriamo una posizione emozionante e versatile con fino al 40% ufficio domestico. Trascorrete almeno tre giorni lavorativi a settimana in ufficio – a Zurigo o Olten. Una giornata di squadra congiunta a settimana si svolge a Olten.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Coordinamento e comunicazione con interfacce interne ed esterne, tra cui gestione della rete, uffici di custodia in diversi paesi, ICSD, CSD, responsabili delle relazioni con i clienti, azioni aziendali, dati master e riconciliazione

• Elaborazione tempestiva di messaggi non-STP Swift (MT54x) da oltre 50 paesi

• Indagine e correzione delle rotture di riconciliazione

• Ottimizzazione continua dei processi di lavorazione, manutenzione e ulteriore sviluppo

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione commerciale di base completata; idealmente con qualificazione bancaria o comparabile

• Competenza approfondita nel settore dei titoli, nonché esperienza pratica nel business quotidiano; diversi anni di esperienza nel regolamento è auspicabile

• Personalità orientata al team, impegnata con forte iniziativa e chiare capacità di comunicazione orientate al destinatario

• Metodo di lavoro analitico e strutturato, comprensione rapida e alta affidabilità e un forte senso di responsabilità

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten, Zurich | up to 40% home office possible | Reference 7912

Do you enjoy actively shaping complex financial processes and ensuring that exceptional situations are also solved efficiently? The Settlement Special Services team ensures centralised securities processing services at SIX SIS. In the area of exception handling, we are responsible for monitoring and processing all non-STP-Swift messages as well as various control reports. By proactively controlling our processes and risks, we ensure reliable operation and a high level of service.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a specialist in Settlement who has a desire for varied tasks, responsibility and a dynamic environment. We offer you an exciting, versatile position with up to 40% home office. You spend at least three working days per week in the office – either in Zurich or Olten. A joint team day per week takes place in Olten.

These are your tasks

• Coordination and communication with internal and external interfaces, including network management, custodian offices in different countries, ICSDs, CSDs, client relationship managers, corporate actions, valor master data and reconciliation

• Timely processing of non-STP Swift messages (MT54x) from over 50 countries

• Investigation and correction of reconciliation breaks

• Continuous optimization of processing processes as well as maintenance and further development

You bring that with you

• Basic commercial training completed; ideally with banking or comparable qualification

• In-depth expertise in the field of securities, as well as practical experience in day-to-day business; several years of experience in the settlement is desirable

• Team-oriented, committed personality with strong initiative and clear, addressee-oriented communication skills

• Analytical and structured working method, fast comprehension as well as high reliability and a strong sense of responsibility

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska on +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Technical Integration Manager (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Integration Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  80-100% (Working from home up 40%) | Reference 8294

Do you want to work at the intersection of banking services, technology and customer integration? Are you motivated to help banks, partners and internal teams bring secure and stable services into production? Then our SIX BBS team wants to hear from you. We are responsible for onboarding, technical integration and operational support for services such as debiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit and bLink. In this role, you will work closely with banks, customers, software partners, vendors and internal teams across Product, IT, Security, Compliance and Operations. Your focus will be on technical integrations, customer onboarding, testing, go-live preparation, second-level support and a structured handover into regular operations. This is a central interface role between customers, technology and operations, rather than a pure project management, product owner or software engineering role.

What You Will Do

• Coordinate technical integration projects for debiX API and other BBS services such as eBill, Debit and ATM, from initial alignment through go-live and handover to operations.

• Act as the central contact for banks, customers, software partners, vendors, IT partners and internal teams during onboarding, testing, acceptance and production preparation.

• Clarify business, technical and operational requirements for API-based integrations, customer connections, certificates, environments and support processes.

• Support test preparation and execution, issue analysis, customer acceptance, go-live activities, hypercare and the transition into regular operations.

• Provide second-level support for customer requests, interface topics, certificates, integration issues and production-related incidents.

What You Bring

• Experience in technical customer integration, API integration, partner onboarding, service integration or technical project coordination, ideally in banking, payments or another regulated environment.

• Good understanding of REST APIs, XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, mutual TLS, OAuth or comparable security and interface topics.

• Experience with testing, acceptance, go-live preparation, incident handling, second-level support, service management and operational handover.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to banks, customers, business teams, IT partners and vendors.

• Structured, pragmatic and reliable working style with a strong customer focus; fluent German and English, French or Italian is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Responsabile Integrazione Tecnica (80 - 100%)

Zurigo | 80-100% (Lavorare da casa fino al 40%) | Riferimento 8294

Vuoi lavorare all'intersezione dei servizi bancari, della tecnologia e dell'integrazione dei clienti? Sei motivato ad aiutare banche, partner e team interni a portare in produzione servizi sicuri e stabili? Allora il nostro team di SIX BBS vuole sentirti. Siamo responsabili dell'integrazione tecnica e del supporto operativo per servizi quali debiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit e bLink. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con banche, clienti, partner software, fornitori e team interni di prodotto, IT, sicurezza, conformità e operazioni. Il vostro focus sarà sulle integrazioni tecniche, l'accensione del cliente, il test, la preparazione del go-live, il supporto di secondo livello e una consegna strutturata in operazioni regolari. Questo è un ruolo di interfaccia centrale tra clienti, tecnologia e operazioni, piuttosto che un puro ruolo di gestione del progetto, proprietario del prodotto o ingegneria del software.

Cosa farai

• Coordinate i progetti di integrazione tecnica per debiX API e altri servizi BBS come eBill, Debit e ATM, dall'allineamento iniziale attraverso il go-live e il passaggio alle operazioni.

• Agire come contatto centrale per banche, clienti, partner software, fornitori, partner IT e team interni durante la preparazione di bordo, test, accettazione e produzione.

• Verificare i requisiti aziendali, tecnici e operativi per integrazioni basate su API, connessioni ai clienti, certificati, ambienti e processi di supporto.

• Preparazione e esecuzione del test di supporto, analisi dei problemi, accettazione del cliente, attività di go-live, ipercare e la transizione in operazioni regolari.

• Fornire supporto di secondo livello per le richieste dei clienti, argomenti di interfaccia, certificati, problemi di integrazione e incidenti legati alla produzione.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza nell'integrazione tecnica dei clienti, integrazione API, integrazione dei partner, integrazione dei servizi o coordinamento tecnico dei progetti, idealmente nel settore bancario, dei pagamenti o di un altro ambiente regolamentato.

• Buona comprensione delle API REST, XML, JSON, autenticazione, certificati, TLS reciproci, OAuth o simili argomenti di sicurezza e interfaccia.

• Esperienza con test, accettazione, preparazione go-live, gestione degli incidenti, supporto di secondo livello, gestione dei servizi e consegna operativa.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di spiegare chiaramente argomenti tecnici a banche, clienti, team aziendali, partner IT e fornitori.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, pragmatico e affidabile con un forte focus del cliente; fluente tedesco e inglese, francese o italiano è un vantaggio.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

• work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• install, configure, fine-tune, and maintain OpenTelemetry Collectors and telemetry pipelines for applications and platforms

• build and maintain dashboards, alerting, and telemetry flows across distributed tracing, metrics, and logs, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• run and evolve observability services that support modern incident detection, investigation, and operational decision-making

• design, configure, and maintain integrations with event management and ticketing systems for alert routing, incident context, and operational workflows

What You Bring

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, including responsibility for production observability capabilities

• proven experience taking observability capabilities from requirements to production-ready solutions; experience limited to dashboards, queries, or observability backends as a consumer is not sufficient

• practical experience instrumenting applications and infrastructure with OpenTelemetry to generate traces, metrics, and logs

• strong understanding of modern, trace-centric observability practices beyond traditional log-centric monitoring

• experience deploying, configuring, and operating OpenTelemetry Collectors and designing telemetry pipelines is a strong advantage; these will be key hands-on responsibilities in the role

• experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads

• experience with common observability toolchains and backends (e.g.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - Elastic Stack experience considered a plus

• scripting or automation skills to support repeatable deployment, configuration, validation, and ongoing operations using technologies such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ingegnere di osservazione senior

Zurigo | Fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Riferimento 7664

L'Ingegnere per l'Osservabilità Senior è un ruolo pratico incentrato sulla costruzione e sulla fornitura di osservabilità e AIOps come capacità e servizio di ingegneria condivisa. Aiuterai a stabilire come l'osservabilità è progettata, implementata e consumata in team, conducendo i primi onboard e modellando standard pratici, processi e modi di lavoro.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforma, prodotto e applicazioni, tradurrai i requisiti in soluzioni di osservabilità attuabili, implementare e gestire le funzionalità di base e migliorare continuamente come intuizioni, avvisi e automazione supportano servizi affidabili. Come contributore fondamentale al Centro di Eccellenza per l'Osservabilità e l'AIOps, unirete l'esecuzione tecnica profonda con una forte proprietà della qualità del servizio, della disponibilità operativa e della maturità di capacità

Cosa farai

• progettazione, distribuzione e gestione delle capacità di osservazione e AIOps per ambienti cloud-nativi e ibridi, supportando servizi affidabili e di qualità produttiva

• guidare l'imbarco di team e servizi, definendo e applicando gli standard per la strumentazione della telemetria, la raccolta, SLIs, SLOs e l'avviso in sistemi reali utilizzando OpenTelemetry

• lavorare hands-on con team di ingegneria, SRE e operazioni per raccogliere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni di osservazione e automazione attuabili

• installare, configurare, ottimizzare e mantenere OpenTelemetry Collectors e tubazioni di telemetria per applicazioni e piattaforme

• costruire e mantenere cruscotti, avvisi e flussi di telemetria attraverso tracciamento distribuito, metriche e registri, sfruttando OpenTelemetry per fornire informazioni significative e ridurre il rumore operativo

• eseguire ed evolvere servizi di osservabilità che supportano il rilevamento degli incidenti moderni, l'indagine e il processo decisionale operativo

• progettazione, configurazione e mantenimento delle integrazioni con i sistemi di gestione degli eventi e di biglietteria per il routing degli avvisi, il contesto degli incidenti e i flussi di lavoro operativi

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di esperienza pratica nell'osservabilità, SRE, piattaforma o ingegneria dell'affidabilità, compresa la responsabilità delle capacità di osservanza della produzione

• esperienza comprovata prendendo capacità di osservanza da requisiti a soluzioni pronte alla produzione; esperienza limitata a cruscotti, query o backend di osservabilità come un consumatore non è sufficiente

• pratica esperienza strumentazione applicazioni e infrastrutture con OpenTelemetry per generare tracce, metriche e registri

• forte comprensione delle pratiche di osservabilità moderne, traccia-centriche oltre il monitoraggio tradizionale log-centric

• esperienza di distribuzione, configurazione e funzionamento OpenTelemetry Collectors e progettazione di tubazioni di telemetria è un forte vantaggio; questi saranno responsabilità chiave hands-on nel ruolo

• esperienza con ambienti cloud-native, carichi di lavoro basati su Kubernetes

• esperienza con portautensili e backend osservabili comuni (ad esempio: Elastico, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, ecc) - Esperienza elastica Stack considerata un plus

• capacità di scrittura o automazione per supportare le operazioni ripetibili di distribuzione, configurazione, convalida e in corso utilizzando tecnologie come Helm, Terraform e Ansible

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

En tant que contributeur principal au Centre d'excellence Observability & AIOps, vous combinerez une exécution technique profonde et une forte appropriation de la qualité du service, de la disponibilité opérationnelle et de la maturité des capacités

Ce que vous ferez

• concevoir, déployer et exploiter des capacités d'observation et d'IAOps pour des environnements cloud-natifs et hybrides, en supportant des services de qualité de production fiables

• diriger l'embarquement des équipes et des services, définir et appliquer des normes pour l'instrumentation de la télémétrie, la collecte, les SLI, les SLO et l'alerte dans les systèmes du monde réel en utilisant OpenTelemetry

• travailler avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de SRE et d'opérations pour rassembler les exigences et les traduire en solutions actionnables d'observation et d'automatisation

• gérer et développer des services d'observation qui appuient la détection des incidents, les enquêtes et la prise de décisions opérationnelles modernes

• concevoir, configurer et maintenir les intégrations avec les systèmes de gestion des événements et de billetterie pour le routage des alertes, le contexte des incidents et les flux de travail opérationnels

Are you passionate about Privileged Access Management, secrets management, and Identity Security? Join us as a Senior PAM & Secrets Management Engineer and help design secure, scalable access solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Working with Delinea Secret Server and OpenBao, you will protect privileged accounts, secrets, service accounts, APIs, and machine identities while contributing to our Identity Security strategy.

What You Will Do

• Build, configure, and operate modern PAM and secrets management platforms, including Delinea Secret Server and OpenBao.

• Connect PAM and secrets management solutions with technologies such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud platforms, DevOps pipelines, SIEM, ITSM, and enterprise applications.

• Improve onboarding, automation, credential rotation, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operations for privileged accounts and secrets.

• Explore how AI, automation, autonomous agents, and non-human identities are changing IAM, PAM, and Identity Security.

• Contribute ideas, challenge existing approaches, and help build the next generation of secure and efficient PAM capabilities.

What You Bring

• 6+ year hands-on experience with PAM tools, including platform engineering, operations, integrations, and secure lifecycle management.

• Good understanding of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, and hybrid infrastructure environments.

• A solid understanding of privileged access management, secrets management, machine and non-human identities, Zero Trust principles, and emerging AI security topics.

• The ability to look beyond individual tools and design pragmatic solutions that balance security, usability, operations, and regulatory expectations.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to act as a trusted advisor for business, technology, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

jobs.title: AI Software Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Software Architect

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8259

Shape and execute the AI SDLC at SIX · reports to Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. As AI Software Architect, you will set the technical direction for this shift: designing the reference patterns, tooling, and quality gates that make AI-augmented and agentic development safe and effective in a regulated financial market infrastructure, and driving adoption across teams you don't manage.

What You Will Do

• Translate the AI software engineering strategy into working practice. Design, prototype and harden the reference patterns, tooling and reusable components that make AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) real across SIX.

• Set the deepest technical standards for AI-based development: prompt and agent patterns, code review of AI-generated code, and the quality and security gates that make it safe in a regulated FMI.

• Support and execute the people transformation journey, evolving developer roles, team structures, processes and ways of working to unlock the full potential of AI-augmented software engineering

• Run lighthouse engagements hands-on: understand the process of business-unit software teams, baseline and measure impact on real backlogs, and prove value before scaling.

• Drive adoption across teams you don't manage. Coach senior engineers, win over skeptics, and lead the community of practice across CH, ES, PL and IN.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in software engineering with deep with current hands-on expertise across the entire SDLC. You still design software systems, write and review code, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

• Strong systems and architecture thinking across the end-to-end SDLC, and sound judgment on putting AI into a regulated, business-critical environment

• Hands-on experience with AI harness, LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including building custom workflows when off-the-shelf falls short. Claude Code hands-on experience in production is a plus.

• A track record of driving change through influence, not authority. You've won over skeptical senior engineers and spread practice across teams you didn't manage.

• Excellent stakeholder management, low ego and a teaching instinct — equally credible in a design review with a principal engineer and a risk conversation with security; fluent in English, German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

AI Software Architetto

Formare ed eseguire il SDLC AI a SIX · rapporti a capo delle pratiche di ingegneria del software

Agentic AI sta cambiando come il software viene costruito — e a SIX, toccherà il lavoro di più di mille ingegneri. Come AI Software Architect, si imposta la direzione tecnica per questo cambiamento: progettare i modelli di riferimento, strumenti e cancelli di qualità che rendono lo sviluppo AI-augmented e agentic sicuro ed efficace in un'infrastruttura di mercato finanziario regolamentata, e guidare l'adozione in team che non gestisci.

Cosa farai

• Traduci la strategia di ingegneria del software AI nella pratica di lavoro. Progettazione, prototipo e indurimento dei modelli di riferimento, utensili e componenti riutilizzabili che rendono AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) reale attraverso SIX.

• Impostare gli standard tecnici più profondi per lo sviluppo basato su AI: modelli di prompt e agente, la revisione del codice del codice generato dall'IA, e le porte di qualità e sicurezza che lo rendono sicuro in un FMI regolamentato.

• Sostenere ed eseguire il viaggio di trasformazione delle persone, l'evoluzione dei ruoli dello sviluppatore, le strutture del team, i processi e i modi di lavorare per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dell'ingegneria del software aumentata dall'IA

• Eseguire gli impegni del faro hands-on: capire il processo di business-unit software team, baseline e misura l'impatto su backlog reali, e dimostrare il valore prima di scaling.

• Guida l'adozione tra le squadre che non gestisci. Allenatori senior, vincere gli scettici, e guidare la comunità di pratica attraverso CH, ES, PL e IN.

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di ingegneria del software con profonda esperienza pratica in tutto il SDLC. Si progetta ancora sistemi software, scrivere e rivedere il codice, e gli ingegneri si fidano del vostro giudizio tecnico.

• Sistemi e architettura forti che pensano attraverso il SDLC end-to-end, e giudizio sonoro sul mettere l'IA in un ambiente regolamentato, business-critical

• Hands-on esperienza con imbracatura AI, API LLM e quadri di agente, tra cui la costruzione di flussi di lavoro personalizzati quando fuori-the-shelf cade breve. Claude Code esperienza pratica nella produzione è un vantaggio.

• Una traccia di cambiamento di guida attraverso l'influenza, non l'autorità. Hai vinto gli ingegneri senior scettici e la pratica di diffusione in squadre che non hai gestito.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder, basso ego e un istinto di insegnamento — altrettanto credibile in una recensione di progettazione con un ingegnere principale e una conversazione di rischio con la sicurezza; fluente in inglese, tedesco un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

• Conoscenza pratica di SailPoint IIQ/ISC e una solida comprensione dei sistemi e dell'architettura delle applicazioni, tra cui come i sistemi aziendali lavorano insieme.

• Provata esperienza nei requisiti di ingegneria, modellazione dei processi e ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, con sufficiente alfabetizzazione tecnica per valutare la fattibilità, comprendere gli approcci di attuazione e sfidare costruttivamente le proposte tecniche.

• Traduire les besoins des entreprises, des risques et de la réglementation en exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles claires, en modèles de processus, en histoires d'utilisateurs et en critères d'acceptation.

• Former et développer les capacités et les modèles de gouvernance de l'IAM à l'échelle de la main-d'oeuvre IAM, les services en nuage, les identités non humaines, y compris les agents de l'IA, ainsi que le contrôle d'accès fondé sur les politiques, transformant les besoins émergents en processus évolutifs et en concepts de solutions réalisables.

• Élaborer des solutions pour SailPoint IdentityIQ en évaluant les capacités de la plateforme, en définissant les flux de travail et les flux de données et en alignant les concepts avec les ingénieurs et les architectes de l'IAM.

• Analyser les données de l'IAM afin d'identifier les tendances, les causes profondes, les lacunes de contrôle et les possibilités d'automatisation, et présenter des recommandations fondées sur des données probantes.

• Faire le pont entre les parties prenantes et l'équipe de distribution, en soutenant la hiérarchisation, la mise en œuvre, l'essai, le déploiement et l'adoption de solutions durables de MEI.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en tant qu'analyste d'affaires de l'IAM, ingénieur des exigences ou consultant en l'IAM, avec une solide connaissance de l'IAM et de l'IGA, gouvernance d'accès, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, ingénierie des rôles, certifications, séparation des fonctions et exigences de contrôle pertinentes; expérience avec les aspects de l'IAM des services cloud ou des agents d'IA est un avantage.

• Expérience éprouvée de l'ingénierie des besoins, de la modélisation des processus et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, avec suffisamment de connaissances techniques pour évaluer la faisabilité, comprendre les approches de mise en œuvre et contester de manière constructive les propositions techniques.

• Forte capacité d'analyse et de données, y compris les outils SQL et BI (Python est un avantage), avec la capacité de transformer l'information complexe en décisions saines et des recommandations claires.

jobs.title: Regulatory Data Analyst (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Regulatory Data Analyst (80-100%)

Zurich |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8334

Do you want to contribute to the integrity and transparency of Swiss financial markets through data-driven surveillance and regulatory oversight?
Within SIX Exchange Regulation, the Surveillance Assurance & Development team is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities, data quality and the evolution of surveillance systems and methodologies.
As a Regulatory Data Analyst, you will act as the subject matter expert for Transaction Reporting under MiFID II (RTS 22) and Swiss FMIA requirements and help ensure that Transaction Reporting data is complete, accurate and fit for surveillance, compliance and enforcement purposes. You will work closely with Surveillance, Enforcement & Compliance and IT teams and contribute to the ongoing development of surveillance capabilities and data quality.

What You Will Do

• Act as the subject matter expert for Transaction Reporting, including MiFID II (RTS 22) and Swiss FMIA reporting requirements.

• Analyze transaction reporting data, perform data quality reviews and investigate reporting deficiencies, anomalies and completeness issues.

• Conduct analyses based on transaction reporting data and provide expert support to surveillance, compliance and enforcement activities, including investigations, requests from regulatory and supervisory authorities, and reporting-related assessments.

• Provide Transaction Reporting expertise and contribute to surveillance initiatives, regulatory changes, system enhancements and continuous improvement of transaction reporting data quality in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.

What You Bring

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience in finance, capital markets or stock exchange environments. Good understanding of trading activities and financial instruments (e.g. equities, bonds, ETFs, warrants and derivatives). Experience in regulatory transaction reporting is a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical mindset and good SQL and Python knowledge with the ability to analyze, investigate and validate large datasets. Experience with Databricks and PySpark is an advantage.

• High attention to detail, proactive working style and strong communication skills.

• Fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Nell'ambito di SIX Exchange Regulation, il team Surveillance Assurance & Development è responsabile del continuo miglioramento delle capacità di sorveglianza, della qualità dei dati e dell'evoluzione dei sistemi di sorveglianza e delle metodologie.
In qualità di analista dei dati regolamentari, l'utente agirà come esperto in materia di report sulle transazioni ai sensi dei requisiti MiFID II (RTS 22) e Swiss FMIA e vi aiuterà a garantire che i dati di Transaction Reporting siano completi, accurati e idonei a fini di sorveglianza, conformità e applicazione. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Sorveglianza, Enforcement & Compliance e IT e contribuire allo sviluppo continuo delle capacità di sorveglianza e della qualità dei dati.

Cosa farai

• Agire come esperto in materia di Reporting Transaction, compresi i requisiti di report MiFID II (RTS 22) e Swiss FMIA.

• Analizzare i dati di report sulle transazioni, eseguire recensioni sulla qualità dei dati e indagare sulle carenze di reportistica, anomalie e problemi di completezza.

• Condurre analisi basate sui dati di report delle transazioni e fornire un supporto esperto alle attività di sorveglianza, conformità e esecuzione, comprese le indagini, le richieste delle autorità di controllo e di regolamentazione e le valutazioni relative alla reportistica.

• Fornire competenze di Reporting Transaction e contribuire a iniziative di sorveglianza, cambiamenti normativi, miglioramenti del sistema e miglioramento continuo della qualità dei dati di report delle transazioni in collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Scienza informatica o un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza professionale.

• Esperienza nella finanza, nei mercati dei capitali o negli ambienti delle borse. Buona comprensione delle attività di trading e degli strumenti finanziari (ad esempio azioni, obbligazioni, ETF, garanzie e derivati). L'esperienza nel reporting delle transazioni regolamentari è un forte vantaggio.

• Forte mentalità analitica e buona conoscenza SQL e Python con la capacità di analizzare, indagare e convalidare grandi dataset. L'esperienza con Databricks e PySpark è un vantaggio.

• Alta attenzione ai dettagli, stile di lavoro proattivo e forti capacità di comunicazione.

• È richiesto l'inglese fluente; le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41583998670 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

Spécialiste des licences de données (100%)

Zurich: jusqu'à 40 % de travail à domicile possible

Vous cherchez à développer votre carrière dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif? Nous cherchons un spécialiste de la gestion des licences de données expérimenté pour rejoindre l'équipe de gestion des licences de données. Ce rôle est chargé de gérer l'octroi de licences aux fournisseurs de données tiers, la gouvernance commerciale, le contrôle des droits, la déclaration des fournisseurs et la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des produits de données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

En tant qu'expert reconnu, vous veillerez à ce que les exigences contractuelles du fournisseur se traduisent par des processus opérationnels efficaces, des configurations de produits, des communications avec les clients, des contrôles de conformité et des obligations de déclaration. Vous jouerez également un rôle clé dans l'automatisation de la conduite, l'excellence opérationnelle et la prise de décision axée sur les données.

Ce que vous ferez

• Autoriser et régir le cycle de vie des services de données et de licences de tiers, en veillant au respect des accords avec les fournisseurs, des exigences réglementaires et des politiques internes.

• Diriger la mise en oeuvre et la surveillance des cadres d'octroi de licences aux fournisseurs, des modèles de droits et des contrôles commerciaux pour tous les produits et services.

• Favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle grâce à l'optimisation des processus, à des initiatives d'automatisation et à l'établissement de cadres de gouvernance et de contrôle durables.

• Gérer les relations complexes entre les intervenants et les fournisseurs de données et les partenaires internes, en tant que principal point de contact pour les questions de licence, de conformité et d'exploitation.

• Superviser les activités d'administration des produits et des droits, en veillant à la mise en oeuvre et au maintien exacts des structures d'accès aux données et des exigences opérationnelles.

• Déterminer, évaluer et atténuer les risques liés à la délivrance de permis, à la conformité et aux opérations tout en appuyant les activités de vérification, de rapport et de gouvernance.

• Fournir des conseils spécialisés et un leadership en ce qui a trait à l'octroi de licences de données sur le marché, aux politiques des fournisseurs et aux initiatives stratégiques ayant une incidence sur l'organisation.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière de données sur le marché, de données de référence, de services d'information financière, de licences, de droits ou d'environnement de services financiers connexes.

• Bonne compréhension des exigences en matière de licence de données, d'accords commerciaux, de cadres de gouvernance et de conformité.

• Compétence technique avancée en Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, outils compatibles avec l'IA et analyse de données, avec la capacité de conduire l'automatisation et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

• Capacité éprouvée de gérer des relations complexes avec les intervenants et de diriger des initiatives interfonctionnelles à l'échelle des entreprises, de la technologie, des opérations et des organisations fournisseurs.

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand, combinée à de solides capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de gestion des risques dans des environnements réglementés et contrôlés.

Zurich |  up to 40% home office possible | Reference 8299

Do you want to help shape the future direction of SIX’s IT organization? Are you passionate about IT strategy, operating models and turning complex topics into actionable recommendations? Then the CIO Office wants to hear from you.

As part of a lean and high-performing team, you will work alongside the CIO Office Head and the Senior IT Strategy Manager to shape SIX’s IT Strategy, evolve the IT Operating Model and develop recommendations for senior leadership in an AI-enabled world.

You will work on the substance behind strategic decisions, including hypothesis development, strategic analysis, content creation, executive story-lining and recommendation development.

This role is ideal for a hands-on strategy professional who enjoys solving complex problems, building fact-based recommendations and turning ideas into results. As an individual contributor in a small, high-impact team, you will shape some of the most important strategic topics in SIX IT, partnering closely with senior leadership.

What You Will Do

• Co-create SIX’s IT Strategy and strategic roadmap , ensuring alignment with business priorities

• Help shape the evolution of the IT Operating Model and future organizational design

• Develop recommendations on how IT can better support business priorities and strategic objectives

• Structure complex challenges and develop fact-based hypotheses, recommendations, and strategic assessments

• Conduct analyses and benchmarking to support strategic decision-making

• Prepare executive-ready presentations and decision materials and compelling narratives for complex technology topics

• Support strategic discussions with senior management and governance bodies and partner with leaders across IT and business functions

• Drive strategic topics from analysis through recommendation and contribute hands-on to workshops, assessments, and strategic initiatives

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, IT strategy, corporate strategy, operating model design or a comparable strategic role

• Proven experience in strategy development and/or operating model design

• Strong strategic and analytical problem-solving skills , with the ability to turn ambiguity into actionable recommendations

• Excellent communication, presentation and story-lining skills , including the ability to create executive-ready materials

• A hands-on, structured and pragmatic approach, with a strong can-do attitude and the ability to independently drive topics to outcomes

• A self-driven and collaborative mindset , with a passion for developing analyses, concepts, presentations and recommendations hands-on

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field

• Fluency in English is required; German is a strong plus

Do you want to help shape the future direction of SIX’s IT organization? Are you passionate about IT strategy, operating models and turning complex topics into actionable recommendations? Then the CIO Office wants to hear from you.

As part of a lean and high-performing team, you will work alongside the CIO Office Head and the Senior IT Strategy Manager to shape SIX’s IT Strategy, evolve the IT Operating Model and develop recommendations for senior leadership in an AI-enabled world.

This role is ideal for a hands-on strategy professional who enjoys solving complex problems, building fact-based recommendations and turning ideas into results. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Gestionnaire principal de la TI (Focus Stratégie de TI et modèle opérationnel) - Bureau du DPI (80 - 100 %)

Zurich jusqu'à 40% bureau à domicile possible

Voulez-vous aider à façonner la direction future de l'organisation informatique SIX? Êtes-vous passionné par la stratégie informatique, les modèles opérationnels et la transformation de sujets complexes en recommandations réalisables? Alors, le bureau des DPI veut vous entendre.

Dans le cadre d'une équipe maigre et performante, vous travaillerez avec le chef de bureau du CIO et le gestionnaire principal de la stratégie de la TI pour façonner la stratégie de la TI de SIX, développer le modèle d'exploitation de la TI et élaborer des recommandations à l'intention des cadres supérieurs dans un monde à l'IA.

Vous travaillerez sur le fond des décisions stratégiques, y compris l'élaboration d'hypothèses, l'analyse stratégique, la création de contenu, l'histoire de la direction et l'élaboration de recommandations.

Ce rôle est idéal pour un professionnel de la stratégie pratique qui aime résoudre des problèmes complexes, élaborer des recommandations factuelles et transformer les idées en résultats. En tant que contributeur individuel dans une petite équipe à impact élevé, vous façonnerez certains des sujets stratégiques les plus importants de SIX IT, en partenariat étroit avec les cadres supérieurs.

Ce que vous ferez

• Co-créer la stratégie informatique et la feuille de route stratégique SIX, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités opérationnelles

• Aider à façonner l'évolution du modèle d'exploitation des TI et la conception organisationnelle future

• Élaborer des recommandations sur la façon dont les TI peuvent mieux appuyer les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs stratégiques

• Structurer les défis complexes et élaborer des hypothèses factuelles, des recommandations et des évaluations stratégiques

• Effectuer des analyses et des analyses comparatives pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques

• Préparer des présentations et des documents décisionnels prêts à l'exécution et des récits convaincants pour des sujets technologiques complexes

• Appuyer les discussions stratégiques avec les cadres supérieurs et les organes de gouvernance et établir des partenariats avec les dirigeants dans l'ensemble des fonctions informatiques et opérationnelles

• Diriger les sujets stratégiques de l'analyse à la recommandation et contribuer directement aux ateliers, aux évaluations et aux initiatives stratégiques

Ce que vous apportez

• 5+ ans d'expérience en conseil en gestion, stratégie informatique, stratégie d'entreprise, conception de modèles opérationnels ou un rôle stratégique comparable

• Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration de stratégies et/ou la conception de modèles opérationnels

• Fortes compétences stratégiques et analytiques en résolution de problèmes , avec la capacité de transformer l'ambiguïté en recommandations réalisables

• Excellentes compétences en communication, présentation et histoire, y compris la capacité de créer des documents prêts à l'emploi

• Une approche pratique, structurée et pragmatique, avec une forte attitude de candeur et la capacité d'orienter indépendamment les sujets vers les résultats

• Une mentalité autodidacte et collaborative, passionnée par le développement d'analyses, de concepts, de présentations et de recommandations pratiques

• Licence ou maîtrise en affaires, économie, technologie de l'information, ingénierie ou un domaine connexe

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; l'allemand est un fort plus

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Internship Project & Portfolio Management and Project Controlling 80-100%

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8378

SIX runs the infrastructure behind the Swiss and Spanish financial markets: exchanges, post-trade, financial information and banking services. Every year, SIX invests a substantial budget in projects that shape that infrastructure. Our team makes sure that money goes to the right places, delivers what was promised, and gives the Executive Board a clear view of the whole portfolio.

We are rebuilding how SIX manages its project portfolio. This includes a new framework for allocating investment capital, sharper decision formats for the Executive Board, and new ways to fund fast-moving initiatives such as AI. This is a period of active redesign, not maintenance. You will join a small, senior team in the middle of it. This internship is limited to 6 months.

What you will do

• Run the monthly project controlling close. As closing manager, you coordinate actuals, forecasts and variances across the portfolio, and you challenge the numbers before they reach management.

• Build the portfolio view for senior management. You prepare reporting, dashboards and briefing material for the Executive Board and its committees. That means turning data from dozens of projects into a few messages a decision-maker can act on.

• Work alongside the Portfolio Manager and project controllers on project reviews: Is the business case still valid? Are budget, scope and timeline realistic? What should leadership know that the status report doesn’t say?

• Shape the methodology. You help design and test new templates, decision criteria and governance formats, and you see them used in real investment decisions.
Find smarter ways to work. You use data analysis, Excel and modeling, and AI tools to automate reporting and surface insight faster. Good ideas get implemented.

• Take on a defined analytical project of your own, for example benchmarking how other FMIs and banks allocate capital, or analyzing what has driven cost and schedule overruns in our portfolio. You present your findings to the team leadership at the end of your internship.

What you bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field, with a strong academic record

• A genuine interest in corporate finance, strategy and how large organizations make investment decisions

• Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable in Excel, can build a clean model, and know that a number without a story is useless

• Clear writing and visual thinking: you can compress a complex situation into one slide

• Rigor and reliability: You will be handling numbers that management relies on, and you notice when something doesn’t add up.

• Initiative: you suggest improvements rather than waiting to be asked

• Fluent in German and English

• Prior experience in consulting, audit, banking or corporate finance is a plus, not a requirement

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Internship Project & Portfolio Management e Project Controlling 80-100%

Zurigo | 80-100% | Riferimento 8378

SIX gestisce l'infrastruttura dietro i mercati finanziari svizzeri e spagnoli: scambi, post-commercializzazione, informazioni finanziarie e servizi bancari. Ogni anno, SIX investe un bilancio sostanziale in progetti che modellano tale infrastruttura. Il nostro team si assicura che i soldi vadano ai posti giusti, consegna ciò che è stato promesso, e dà al Consiglio Esecutivo una chiara visione dell'intero portafoglio.

Stiamo ricostruendo come SIX gestisce il suo portafoglio di progetti. Questo include un nuovo quadro per l'assegnazione di capitale di investimento, formati decisioni più taglienti per il Consiglio Esecutivo, e nuovi modi per finanziare iniziative in rapida evoluzione come l'AI. Questo è un periodo di riprogettazione attiva, non manutenzione. Ti unirai a una piccola squadra senior nel bel mezzo. Questo tirocinio è limitato a 6 mesi.

Cosa farai

SIX runs the infrastructure behind the Swiss and Spanish financial markets: exchanges, post-trade, financial information and banking services. Every year, SIX invests a substantial budget in projects that shape that infrastructure. Our team makes sure that money goes to the right places, delivers what was promised, and gives the Executive Board a clear view of the whole portfolio.

We are rebuilding how SIX manages its project portfolio. This includes a new framework for allocating investment capital, sharper decision formats for the Executive Board, and new ways to fund fast-moving initiatives such as AI. This is a period of active redesign, not maintenance. You will join a small, senior team in the middle of it. This internship is limited to 6 months.

What you will do

• Run the monthly project controlling close. As closing manager, you coordinate actuals, forecasts and variances across the portfolio, and you challenge the numbers before they reach management.

• Build the portfolio view for senior management. You prepare reporting, dashboards and briefing material for the Executive Board and its committees. That means turning data from dozens of projects into a few messages a decision-maker can act on.

• Work alongside the Portfolio Manager and project controllers on project reviews: Is the business case still valid? Are budget, scope and timeline realistic? What should leadership know that the status report doesn’t say?

• Shape the methodology. You help design and test new templates, decision criteria and governance formats, and you see them used in real investment decisions.
Find smarter ways to work. You use data analysis, Excel and modeling, and AI tools to automate reporting and surface insight faster. Good ideas get implemented.

• Take on a defined analytical project of your own, for example benchmarking how other FMIs and banks allocate capital, or analyzing what has driven cost and schedule overruns in our portfolio. You present your findings to the team leadership at the end of your internship.

What you bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering or a related field, with a strong academic record

• A genuine interest in corporate finance, strategy and how large organizations make investment decisions

• Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable in Excel, can build a clean model, and know that a number without a story is useless

• Clear writing and visual thinking: you can compress a complex situation into one slide

• Rigor and reliability: You will be handling numbers that management relies on, and you notice when something doesn’t add up.

• Initiative: you suggest improvements rather than waiting to be asked

• Fluent in German and English

• Prior experience in consulting, audit, banking or corporate finance is a plus, not a requirement

Gestionnaire principal de l'acquisition des données (80-100%)

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8372

Souhaitez-vous façonner la stratégie d'acquisition de données financières de SIX et gérer les relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs de données mondiaux? Apportez-vous une solide connaissance des marchés financiers, une expérience éprouvée dans les négociations commerciales complexes et une approche pratique de la technologie et de l'automatisation?
Rejoignez notre équipe d'acquisition de données et prenez possession d'un portefeuille de fournisseurs diversifié, stimulez la valeur grâce à l'approvisionnement stratégique et aidez à faire évoluer la façon dont nous acquérons et gérons les données financières.
Postulez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais. Nous avons hâte de vous entendre.

Ce que vous ferez

• Posséder les relations commerciales et contractuelles de bout en bout avec les fournisseurs de données stratégiques, mener des négociations complexes, examiner les contrats, développer les fournisseurs et évaluer les risques.

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de fournisseurs et de négociations conformes aux priorités opérationnelles, en établissant un équilibre entre les coûts, les exigences en matière de données, les droits de licence et la valeur à long terme.

• Définer les modèles commerciaux existants et les accords de licence, déterminer les possibilités d'optimisation des coûts, de regroupement des fournisseurs et d'amélioration de la flexibilité contractuelle.

• Agir en tant que partenaire principal de la gestion des produits, des opérations, de la législation, de la conformité et d'autres intervenants, traduire les besoins opérationnels en décisions pratiques en matière d'approvisionnement et résoudre les problèmes complexes des fournisseurs.

• Déterminer et évaluer les nouvelles possibilités de données, suivre l'évolution de l'industrie et transformer les perspectives du marché en recommandations pour le portefeuille des fournisseurs et la stratégie d'approvisionnement.

• Gérer les coûts d'acquisition, suivre les économies et les autres ICR pertinents, et fournir des recommandations claires et des rapports pour appuyer les décisions de gestion.

• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations basées sur l'IA, construire des agents pratiques et des solutions d'automatisation en plus de vos responsabilités de gestion des fournisseurs.

• Partager l'expertise et soutenir les collègues sur des sujets complexes liés aux fournisseurs, aux contrats et aux processus.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière d'acquisition de données financières, d'acquisition de données de marché ou d'un rôle commercial comparable, avec une bonne connaissance des échanges, agences de notation, contributeurs et autres fournisseurs de données.

• Une expérience éprouvée de la conduite indépendante de négociations complexes avec les fournisseurs et la fourniture d'une valeur commerciale mesurable.

• Une bonne compréhension des licences de données et des cadres contractuels, avec la capacité d'évaluer les droits d'utilisation, les restrictions, les obligations et les risques commerciaux.

• Le jugement stratégique combiné à une approche pratique, la confiance dans la remise en question des ententes établies et la capacité de transformer l'analyse en décisions claires.

• Des compétences solides en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer les différentes fonctions et de naviguer sur des priorités concurrentes.

• Un profil professionnel, techniquement confiant, avec une vaste expérience d'application de l'IA et des agents de construction pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires pratiques.

• La connaissance de Python, VBA et Power BI est un avantage.

• Un état d'esprit indépendant axé sur la solution, une forte appropriation et une volonté de partager les connaissances et d'aider à renforcer les capacités de l'équipe.

• Excellent anglais écrit et parlé; les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage.

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
